rules: Avoid default Inter for main headings.
Use extreme legibility for POS mode (Manrope is highly legible).
Tight letter spacing on large text, generous on body.
Use bold/heavy weights sparingly; favor medium or normal for a premium fashion feel.
No full-screen gradients. Keep it monochrome and structural.
Never use pure black or pure gray; tint with a subtle warmth or cool tone if needed, but for fashion, high-contrast monochrome (Black/White) is preferred.
Primary CTA buttons must be solid black.
Ensure text over images has a subtle gradient overlay or text-shadow for APCA contrast compliance.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces with crisp 1px borders (border-black/10). Avoid heavy soft UI / Neumorphism.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E4E4E7. Use border-collapse for tables and data grids.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for floating elements (dropdowns, modals) and no shadow for base cards (rely on borders).
visual_enhancers.radii: Subtle. rounded-md (6px) or rounded-sm (4px). Avoid overly pill-shaped containers except for specific badges or small buttons.

recommended: Button (sharp corners or slight radius, pure black primary)
Input / Select / Form (for POS barcode entry, product creation)
Dialog (for Quick View, Shopify Sync details)
Tabs (for switching between Area Donna, Area Uomo, Shopify)
Sonner (for Toast notifications like 'Sync completed', 'Item added to cart')
Badge (for variants, colors, sizes, stock status)

grids.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid (cols-1 md:cols-3 lg:cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use standard tall widgets for 'ultimi movimenti'.
grids.pos_mode: Bento-style or split pane. Left/Top: Product Grid/Scanner (cols-3 or cols-4). Right/Bottom: Current Cart/Order summary (col-span-1 fixed).
grids.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy (p-6, p-8) for dashboard layout, but dense enough for POS to minimize scrolling on tablets.

layouts.navigation: Sidebar on the left. Must contain: Dashboard, Vendite (POS, Storico), Prodotti, Magazzino, Ordini, Clienti, Importa, Promozioni, Integrazioni, Sistema.
layouts.header: Top bar for User Profile, Location Switcher (LOCATION_DONNA_1, LOCATION_DONNA_2, LOCATION_UOMO), and global search/barcode scanner input.
layouts.responsive: Tablet-optimized. POS must have minimum 44x44px touch targets. Sidebar can collapse into icons on tablet portrait.

motion.transitions: Subtle and fast. Use CSS transitions for hover states (opacity, border color, slight transform).
motion.lists: Staggered fade-in for product grids or inventory lists.
rules: Provide immediate visual feedback for POS actions (add to cart, scan).

accessibility.contrast: Maintain WCAG AA minimums. Dark text on light backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:ring-offset-2) for barcode scanner inputs and POS buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="pos-scan-input"`, `data-testid="add-to-cart-button"`).
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons in POS.

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. If real images are needed, use the ones provided above.

3d_libraries.reason: This is an administrative and POS software. 3D elements will distract from operational efficiency. Focus on 2D data clarity and speed.

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js and .jsx files, NOT .tsx files. Write all React code in standard modern JavaScript (.jsx).
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
Implement an Italian language menu (Dashboard, Vendite, Prodotti, Magazzino, Ordini, Clienti, Importa, Promozioni, Integrazioni, Sistema).
Set currency formats to EUR and timezone logic to Europe/Rome.
Create a clean, monochrome (black/white/gray) UI that feels like a high-end fashion brand's internal tool (e.g., SSENSE, Zara). It MUST NOT look like standard developer SaaS.
Optimize tables and inputs for tablet usage (store POS). Use larger padding on interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Use sharp 1px borders, pure flat backgrounds, and high contrast typography to create an editorial, premium software feel.
Avoid overly rounded corners; use rounded-md or sharp corners.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep styling flat and minimal (no deep shadows).
Never apply `transition: all`. Always specify properties (e.g., `transition: background-color 0.2s ease`).
Do not center align the app container. Respect left-alignment for data and reading flow.
Use modern button styles (pure black, sharp edges or slight radius, clear hover states).
Use Lucide-react for standard icons, but keep them minimal (1px stroke if possible).
All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes.
